assets: MLS group secrets, epoch secrets and derived index keys
index contents, postings, result identifiers and access patterns
attestation challenge, evidence, endorsement, reference values and appraisal
cached query tokens, sealed state, audit/lineage and revocation evidence
adversaries: revoked or cross-scope member holding cached material
rollback of sealed state, index epoch or reference values
provider payload claiming trust or capability expansion
crash, timeout, partial write and unknown outcome
trusted_computing_base: PoC model code (frozen, hashed) plus Python 3.12 stdlib it runs on
host-owned appraisal inputs: trust anchors, reference values, endorsements, appraisal policy version, challenge nonces
AgentOS Gateway/Gate allow/deny path (unchanged, unobserved by analytics)
explicitly_untrusted: host OS/storage/network outside the modeled boundary
provider payloads claiming attested=true or capability grants
mock quotes (protocol-shape only, zero hardware force)
any sealed-state snapshot offered after a crash
assumptions: bounded corpus and bounded state space (declared per scenario)
deterministic single-host execution for replay equality
monotonic clock for elapsed measurement; UTC wall for audit labels only
redaction receipts are honest about omitted-entity counts
unknowns_not_measured: rollback guarantees of real sealed storage
production topology, SLOs and key ceremonies
hardware TEE behavior of any kind (hardware_tee_evidence=NOT_MEASURED)
unknown_rule: every UNKNOWN/NOT_MEASURED cell carries no score by default and becomes a named limitation
residual_risks: model-scale evidence says nothing about hardware, side channels or production
redaction receipts expose omitted-entity counts by design
single-operator review is not a security certification
